depwire._setup: After connecting, call the connect_repo tool with the project root path before any graph queries.

serena._setup: Run serena init in the project root first to create .serena/project.yml. Server will be unavailable until initialized.

_note: agentcore-gateway, devin/github-mcp-server, devin/mcp-playwright, and devin/vercel are in the GLOBAL Devin config at AppData/Roaming/devin/mcp_config.json — do not duplicate here. This file adds only project-scoped servers.
